headline: Jensen Huang Resigns As Nvidia CEO Following Personal Scandal
seoTitle: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal
metaDescription: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned after reports of extramarital affairs, including allegations involving a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has stepped down as CEO of Nvidia following public reports regarding his personal life.
Reports indicate one of the relationships involved a woman accused by American authorities of being a Chinese intelligence operative.
Nvidia shares fell by more than 14 percent on the Nasdaq, reaching their lowest valuation in 16 months.
aiContextParagraph: Nvidia confirmed on November 12, 2026, that co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as CEO. The announcement follows allegations concerning the executive's extramarital affairs, including one involving a woman suspected by U.S. authorities of working as a Chinese spy, an allegation the Chinese government has denied. Following the resignation, Nvidia announced that CFO and Executive Vice President Colette Kress would assume the role of interim CEO. The market responded negatively to the news, with Nvidia shares experiencing a decline of over 14 percent on the Nasdaq exchange, marking the company's lowest share value in 16 months. The situation has prompted broader industry concern, with reports suggesting that other companies are reevaluating chip export plans and seeking alternative suppliers in the wake of the leadership transition and related security concerns.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction due to the high-profile nature of the departure and its immediate, substantial impact on Nvidia's market value.
